ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a vertical cylindrical silo, with the side height labeled as 80 and the bottom diameter labeled as 30. On the side of the cylinder there is a band-shaped stripe that slants around the cylinder rising/descending, and the stripe boundaries are parallel spiral lines; in the figure, a small horizontal arrow is used to mark the horizontal width of the stripe as 3. The problem text states that this red stripe wraps around the cylinder two full turns. Reasoning: According to the method, cut the side of the cylinder along a vertical line and unfold it into a rectangle. After unfolding, each horizontal line represents the circumferential cross section at a certain height of the cylinder. Because the “horizontal width” of the stripe is 3 feet, on the horizontal cross section at any height, the horizontal length occupied by the stripe is always 3 feet. The stripe wrapping two turns only changes the degree of inclination of the stripe in the unfolded diagram, and does not change the horizontal length covered by the stripe on each horizontal cross section. Therefore the area can be accumulated by horizontal cross sections: area = 3 × 80 = 240 square feet.

raw_record.question_text: A white cylindrical silo has a diameter of 30 feet and a height of 80 feet. A red stripe with a horizontal width of 3 feet is painted on the silo, as shown, making two complete revolutions around it. What is the area of the stripe in square feet?

method.method_draft: Use a cylinder net and horizontal cross-sections. First read the image: the silo is a vertical cylinder, the stripe is a diagonal helical band wrapping around it, the side height is labeled 80, the diameter is labeled 30, and the stripe’s horizontal thickness is marked 3. Read from the text that the stripe makes two complete revolutions, but note that this only affects how the band slants. Mentally cut and unroll the cylinder into a rectangle. On this rectangle, each horizontal line across the net represents a circular cross-section of the silo, and the stripe occupies exactly 3 feet of horizontal length along that line. Since this happens for the full 80-foot height, integrate/sum horizontal stripe length over height: area = 3 × 80 = 240 square feet.
